title: BreachTestVectors
description: Language-neutral test vectors for the breach check layer. Unlike strength/feedback vectors, breach vectors assert EXACT SHA-1 values because SHA-1 is standardized and deterministic across all implementations.

description.description: Human-readable label for the test case.

password.description: Synthetic test password (never use real credentials).

sha1.description: Full uppercase hex SHA-1 hash of the password.

prefix.description: First 5 hex characters of the SHA-1 hash (sent to HIBP).

suffix.description: Remaining 35 hex characters (matched locally, never sent).
